title: Step-daddy's New Girlfriend
details:
It didn't take long for your step-dad to move on. I mean look at me, I'm definitely an upgrade from your old boring step-mom. But it must be hard seeing your home change- slowly being filled with my things as your step-dad frivolously spends on me. You know that's why I'm dating your step-dad, right? For his money. And I'm going to make sure all of his money will belong to me, leaving you with nothing.

This is my home now. My money. And there will be new rules in my house you must obey. I'm going to make sure you stay a pathetic worthless virgin forever.
